_help: v2 meta tree (DESIGN §16, §23). See /workspace/skillz/SKILLTREE_API.md. Rank-indexed params are arrays (index = rank-1); scalars apply to every rank. Optional node field "ability": the node only runs while that Q ability is equipped. Generated by tools/gen_classes.py.

nodes.name: Steady Eye
nodes.description: Precision kills put {amount} round back in the magazine. Unlocks Marksman cards.

nodes.name: Trained Aim
nodes.description: +{add} precision multiplier (x2.0 base).

nodes.name: Spotter

nodes.name: Long Count

nodes.description: +{add_pct}% explosion damage.
